faq.construction.q1: How long does a typical villa build take?
faq.construction.a1: Most villa projects in the Rawai area take 8 to 14 months, depending on size and design complexity.
faq.construction.a2: Yes, we manage the full permitting process with local authorities.
faq.renovation.q1: Can I stay in my home during renovation?
faq.renovation.a1: For partial renovations, often yes. For full renovations, we advise temporary relocation.
faq.renovation.q2: Do you provide a fixed-price quote?
faq.renovation.a2: Yes, after an on-site assessment we provide a detailed, itemized fixed-price quote.
faq.domotics.q1: Can smart home systems be added to an existing house?
faq.domotics.a1: Yes, most systems can be retrofitted with minimal disruption.
faq.domotics.q2: What happens if the internet goes down?
faq.domotics.a2: Core functions like lighting and security continue to work locally without internet access.

hero.headline: Your Trusted Partner for Construction, Renovation & Home Automation
hero.intro: Building or renovating in Phuket is a massive financial opportunity — until it turns into a nightmare. While local labor is cheap, finding reliable quality that meets Western standards is notoriously difficult; unqualified workers often vanish halfway through, leaving you with costly mistakes to fix. Don't learn the hard way by trying to manage it alone. At {{site.name}}, based right here in Rawai, we offer the ultimate balance of affordability and peace of mind. Our proven, long-standing team of certified plumbers, tilers, and craftsmen delivers consistently reliable results under daily supervision — one of the best price-to-quality ratios in Phuket.
